The migrated file is at `out/module.ts`. `npm run size -- out/module.ts` reports 313 bytes (min+gzip), with 95 bytes of your own code.

I did not measure the original's size or run a behaviour comparison, so the equality and own-code-allowance checks are untested. `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` reports errors only in `src/module.ts`, because the lodash type declarations are missing. None are reported for `out/module.ts`.

| lodash | es-toolkit | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `mapValues(scores, fn)` | `mapValues` from `es-toolkit` | Same behaviour. |
| `keyBy(rows, 'name')` | `keyBy` from `es-toolkit` | The strict version only takes a function, so I added the small adapter `(row) => row.name`. When two rows share a name, the later one wins, as in lodash. |
| `fromPairs(pairs)` | `fromPairs` from `es-toolkit/compat` | The strict entry point has no `fromPairs`, so I used the compat one and kept no lodash import. |

Importing all three functions from `es-toolkit/compat` came to 3328 bytes against 313 for the mixed imports, so I kept `mapValues` and `keyBy` on the strict entry point. The exported signatures, `Row` and `Config` are unchanged.
